messages:
Elaine (releases): Heads-up — tonight's tri-region cutover still on for the 00:30 UTC change window. Plan: phased rollout US -> EU -> APAC. Need a quick preflight capacity check and signoff by 22:45 PT. @Jun @Marta @Ryan :alarm_clock:
Jun (eng-runtime): Copy. Kicking off the smoke script against staging-sized load to validate GPU headroom and cache warmup. Will paste results in a few.
deploy-bot: [preflight-check] initiation triggered by Jun at 2024-05-06T04:11:08Z. Checks: pool_util, reserved_buffer, quota_headroom, node_health.
Jun (eng-runtime): preflight raw output:
```
model-serving-pool-us: 72% used (baseline)
model-serving-pool-eu: 55% used
model-serving-pool-apac: 63% used
reserved-buffer: 15% available
simulated-peak-us: 82% transient
gpu-err-count: 0
kv-cache-hit: 78%
```
Marta (eng-sre): Noted — EU maintenance window ends at 21:30 PT (should be clear). APAC has some cold nodes but infra said warmup queued.
Ryan (infra): warming nodes now. Warmup cmd queued: `./tooling/warmup-nodes --region apac --count 8 --priority high` — ETA ~20m. Also verified reserved pool config: `reserved_percent=12`.
Jun (eng-runtime): Given the sims, US looks borderline during simulated peak (82%). Recommend we prepare a pinned fallback model for APAC in case of surge: fallback -> model v1.1.8 (smaller memory, quantized).
Elaine (releases): Actionable plan for tonight:
- Canary US: 5% traffic for 15m, monitor 5xx and p50/p95 latency.
- Ramp EU: 10% then 30% after 10m if green.
- APAC: start pinned fallback ready; normal ramp only if warmups hit target.
- Rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency > 350ms for 5m.
- Escalation: oncall pager if trigger hit.
ops-bot: Change window approved for 00:30-02:30 UTC. Oncall: Marta (eng-sre). SRE SLOs intact.
Marta (eng-sre): I'll own oncall. I'll watch GPU errors, 5xx rate, and the tail latencies. Set me as primary in the rollout doc.
Jun (eng-runtime): I'll prepare the rollback/pin commands. Example pin command ready: `pin-version --region apac --service model-serving --version v1.1.8 --reason "fallback small-quant"`
Elaine (releases): Ryan — release notes + changelog up-to-date? Need PR link.
Ryan (infra): PR #789 updated with notes, known risk (US transient high qps). Also added the pin command and rollback playbook link.
deploy-bot: Scheduled phased rollout: canary_us @ 00:35 UTC -> ramp_eu @ 00:50 UTC -> APAC decision gate @ 01:10 UTC (warmup check). Automated monitors: latency-tracker, error-rate, gpu-errs.
Jun (eng-runtime): I'll also enable prefix caching for the canary slice to reduce token compute.
Marta (eng-sre): Confirm thresholds in the monitor:
- error_rate_alert: threshold=1% over 5m
- p50_alert: threshold=350ms over 5m
- gpu_err_alert: threshold>=1 per minute
All set.
Elaine (releases): LGTM. If no objections by 22:45 PT I'll trigger the deploy. :thumbsup:
Jun (eng-runtime): No objections from runtime. I'll be on slack for the rollout.
Ryan (infra): infra ready; warmups in progress.
Marta (eng-sre): I'll escalate immediately if anything hits thresholds.
Elaine (releases): Thanks team — I'll kick it off unless something changes.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30 minutes until rollout.
notes: canary_plan: US 5% 15m, EU ramp 10%->30%, APAC gate with pin fallback
